plugin_info.details: This plugin contacts the online PubChem database to retrieve properties such as molecular weight, molecular formula, etc.
plugin_info.intro: Get the chemical properties of selected compounds from PubChem.
plugin_info.title: PubChem Properties

user_args.val: This process may take some time for multiple molecules. Check the Jobs panel to monitor progress. The data will be added to the Data panel once complete.
